origin: STEGGATE-GOAL0 / ST-016 decision reconciliation and CL-SG-003/SPE live-binding dependency

stegcore_commit_boundary.ordering: existing admissibility -> coherence gate -> state transition
stegcore_commit_boundary.candidate_binding_scope: bound action, capability surface, state, authority basis, and receipt integrity at the consequence boundary

decision_projection.rule: positive StegCore admissibility may enter the later coherence gate; it is not itself execution authority
negative StegCore admissibility remains negative and cannot become onward authority
defer represents unresolved/pending governance requirements and MUST NOT be collapsed into FAIL_CLOSED

fail_closed_rule: FAIL_CLOSED is reserved for inability to establish a required policy-relevant fact or comparable authority/evidence basis; it is not an alias for StegCore defer.
candidate_binding_rule: The consequence-bearing candidate MUST be identified by the same candidate_id and canonical candidate_hash admitted by StegGate. Retries or reconstruction MUST recompute and compare that hash before consequence. A mismatch is DENY / CANDIDATE_BINDING_MISMATCH.

commitment_candidate.v46_binding: canonicalize the complete governed candidate under the declared canonicalization profile and bind its sha256 identifier into the v4.6 decision receipt

standing_result.note: legacy FAIL-CLOSED spelling is a compatibility surface; v4.6 canonical receipt value is FAIL_CLOSED

authority_boundary: This mapping identifies existing canonical StegCore references and ara compatibility requirements. It does not modify StegCore PR #18, mint continuity evidence, authorize execution, merge, release, publication, or deployment.
